cards.title: Charts slide/overlap after pinning+unpinning the copilot
cards.notes: FIXED, deployed, founder-verified (charts stay put after page switching). Real trigger wasn't the copilot padding (already guarded) — it was page switching: react-grid-layout remounts per page while the grid's col count updated a frame LATE, so a wide page mounted against the previous page's cols and RGL's correctBounds clamped the right charts leftward on top of the others; the next drag-stop then persisted those clamped positions wholesale. cols/width are now derived synchronously from (layout, host width), so a remount can never see mismatched cols.

cards.title: Social buzz: Reddit/StockTwits breadth for the conviction lane (4 phases)
cards.notes: Founder design session 2026-07-05. Doctrine: code detects (mention-velocity anomaly = counts vs rolling 14-day same-ET-hour baseline), LLM interprets (catalyst digging, qualitative only — never sentiment scores); social text = adversarial data (pump risk) behind the untrusted-content guard, influences judgment fields only, never levels. P1 (IN PROGRESS, Composer): accumulator loop — free Reddit JSON (WSB/stocks/investing/StockMarket) + StockTwits trending → social_mentions table + /api/social/buzz|trending with honest 'warming' state until baselines exist (start collecting NOW; the denominator needs weeks). P2: social block in veto-grade + conviction prompts (reinforce/kill with named reasons). P3: buzz-anomaly symbols injected as scan CANDIDATES (capped, source-tagged for A/B) — buzz nominates, the pipeline still has to find something real. P4: buzz alerts, only if P2/P3 prove value in the outcome tracker. No paid social APIs.
